artifact: GRENDEL BC10 fermiophilic-ALP sensitivity (canonical published curve)
source_run: publication campaign of 2026-07-13: 99-point mass grid (0.22-4.75 GeV), 600000-event FONLL production pool, 20000 full-branching Pythia8 decay templates per supported mass, and memory-bounded acceptance MC (EVENT_CHUNK=256, per-chunk seeds)

hypothesis.model: PBC BC10: pseudoscalar ALP with universal SM-fermion couplings
hypothesis.coupling: g_aff = c_f m_f / f with c_f = 1 (BNT arXiv:1708.00443 convention)
hypothesis.convention_note: 1/f here = 2/f_GKOZ (arXiv:2310.03524); map any GKOZ/PBC comparison curve accordingly

physics_inputs.production: b -> s a penguin as B -> K^(i) a summed over the kaon tower (K, K*, K0*, K1, K2*) per GKOZ arXiv:2310.03524; FONLL 14 TeV bottom kinematics (NNPDF4.0 NLO)
physics_inputs.decays: Widths and exclusive branching ratios from arXiv:2501.04525, decoded from pinned SensCalc v1.3.3 inputs; unstable daughters and partonic channels processed with Pythia 8.317 using flat primary multi-body phase space and an equal u/d/s surrogate for the two-gluon channel

analysis.reconstruction: shared GRENDEL 4-hit two-track vertex reco + PR #13 selection, imported from higgs/ and hnl/ (timing chi2 with daughter beta = p/E); full exclusive branching mixture is sampled before reconstruction

column_contract.invf_min: lower 1/f edge of the excluded island [GeV^-1]
column_contract.invf_max: upper 1/f edge of the excluded island [GeV^-1]
column_contract.has_sensitivity: False => no excluded island at that mass (peak_N < 3)
column_contract.peak_N: signal yield at the optimal coupling (max over the 1/f scan)

closure_note: The 2501 decay model produces disconnected sensitive runs at 0.22-0.52, 0.56-0.94, 0.98-1.25, 1.40, and 1.50-3.20 GeV. The first two gaps are the explicitly unsupported eta and eta-prime pole windows. Insensitive rows at 1.30, 1.35, and 1.45 GeV are retained as plot boundaries. Log-yield interpolation between 3.20 and 3.30 GeV places the final closure at 3.2917 GeV.
